```sql
WITH base AS (
    -- Scope the listeners rows
    SELECT
        id,
        username,
        plan,
        country,
        signup_date,
        birth_year,
        interests,
        DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-12-31', signup_date) AS days_since_signup_date,
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', signup_date) AS signup_date_month
    FROM listeners
    WHERE birth_year < 1994
      AND signup_date < DATE '2024-12-21'
),
enriched AS (
    -- Add calculated columns
    SELECT
        id,
        username,
        country,
        signup_date,
        birth_year,
        days_since_signup_date,
        signup_date_month,
        DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-06-30', signup_date_month) AS days_since_signup_date_month,
        LENGTH(TRIM(username)) AS username_len
    FROM base
),
latest_per_key AS (
    -- Keep the latest row per country
    SELECT
        id,
        username,
        country,
        signup_date,
        birth_year,
        days_since_signup_date,
        signup_date_month,
        days_since_signup_date_month,
        username_len
    FROM (
        SELECT
            *,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country ORDER BY days_since_signup_date_month DESC, id DESC) AS row_num
        FROM enriched
    ) ranked
    WHERE row_num = 1
)
SELECT id, measure, amount
FROM (
    SELECT id, days_since_signup_date_month, username_len, days_since_signup_date, birth_year
    FROM latest_per_key
) src
UNPIVOT (
    amount FOR measure IN (days_since_signup_date_month, username_len, days_since_signup_date, birth_year)
) unp
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

base = (
    df_listeners
    .filter((F.col("birth_year") < 1994) & (F.col("signup_date") < F.lit("2024-12-21").cast("date")))
    .select(
        "id",
        "username",
        "plan",
        "country",
        "signup_date",
        "birth_year",
        "interests",
        F.datediff(F.lit("2025-12-31").cast("date"), F.col("signup_date")).alias("days_since_signup_date"),
        F.date_trunc("month", F.col("signup_date")).alias("signup_date_month"),
    )
)

enriched = (
    base
    .select(
        "id",
        "username",
        "country",
        "signup_date",
        "birth_year",
        "days_since_signup_date",
        "signup_date_month",
        F.datediff(F.lit("2025-06-30").cast("date"), F.col("signup_date_month")).alias("days_since_signup_date_month"),
        F.length(F.trim(F.col("username"))).alias("username_len"),
    )
)

latest_per_key = (
    enriched
    .withColumn("row_num", F.row_number().over(Window.partitionBy("country").orderBy(F.col("days_since_signup_date_month").desc(), F.col("id").desc())))
    .filter(F.col("row_num") == 1)
    .drop("row_num")
)

result = (
    latest_per_key
    .select(
        "id",
        "days_since_signup_date_month",
        "username_len",
        "days_since_signup_date",
        "birth_year",
    )
    .unpivot(
        ids=["id"],
        values=["days_since_signup_date_month", "username_len", "days_since_signup_date", "birth_year"],
        variableColumnName="measure",
        valueColumnName="amount",
    )
    .filter(F.col("amount").isNotNull())
)
```

```sql
WITH base_gates AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        terminal_id,
        lane_throughput,
        opened_on,
        service_codes,
        COALESCE(bag_state, 'UNKNOWN') AS bag_state_or_unknown,
        YEAR(opened_on) AS opened_on_year,
        CASE WHEN bag_state IN ('delayed', 'lost') THEN 'group_a' WHEN bag_state = 'claimed' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS bag_state_group
    FROM gates
),
terminal_id_stats AS (
    -- Avg opened_on_year per terminal_id
    SELECT terminal_id, AVG(opened_on_year) AS avg_opened_on_year
    FROM base_gates
    GROUP BY terminal_id
),
outliers AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.avg_opened_on_year,
        ROUND(s.opened_on_year - g.avg_opened_on_year, 2) AS opened_on_year_minus_avg
    FROM base_gates s
    JOIN terminal_id_stats g ON g.terminal_id = s.terminal_id
    WHERE s.opened_on_year > g.avg_opened_on_year
),
gate_stats AS (
    -- Per-terminal gates metrics
    SELECT
        terminal_id,
        MAX(opened_on) AS last_gate_opened_on,
        COUNT(*) AS gate_count,
        COUNT(*) AS gate_count_2
    FROM gates
    GROUP BY terminal_id
),
profiled AS (
    -- Attach gates metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.last_gate_opened_on,
        COALESCE(g.gate_count, 0) AS gate_count,
        COALESCE(g.gate_count_2, 0) AS gate_count_2
    FROM outliers s
    LEFT JOIN gate_stats g ON g.terminal_id = s.terminal_id
),
summary AS (
    -- Group-level totals
    SELECT
        opened_on_year,
        MAX(gate_count_2) AS max_gate_count_2,
        DATEDIFF(MAX(last_gate_opened_on), MIN(last_gate_opened_on)) AS last_gate_opened_on_span_days
    FROM profiled
    WHERE terminal_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 1
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    opened_on_year,
    max_gate_count_2,
    last_gate_opened_on_span_days,
    COALESCE(opened_on_year, 0) AS opened_on_year_filled
FROM summary
WHERE opened_on_year <= 2025
ORDER BY opened_on_year_filled, opened_on_year
LIMIT 10
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

base_gates = (
    df_gates
    .select(
        "id",
        "terminal_id",
        "lane_throughput",
        "opened_on",
        "service_codes",
        F.coalesce(F.col("bag_state"), F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("bag_state_or_unknown"),
        F.year(F.col("opened_on")).alias("opened_on_year"),
        F.when(F.col("bag_state").isin("delayed", "lost"), "group_a").when(F.col("bag_state") == "claimed", "group_b").otherwise("other").alias("bag_state_group"),
    )
)

terminal_id_stats = (
    base_gates
    .groupBy("terminal_id")
    .agg(F.avg("opened_on_year").alias("avg_opened_on_year"))
)

outliers = (
    base_gates.alias("s")
    .join(terminal_id_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.terminal_id") == F.col("s.terminal_id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.opened_on_year") > F.col("g.avg_opened_on_year"))
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "g.avg_opened_on_year",
        F.round(F.col("s.opened_on_year") - F.col("g.avg_opened_on_year"), 2).alias("opened_on_year_minus_avg"),
    )
)

gate_stats = (
    df_gates
    .groupBy("terminal_id")
    .agg(
        F.max("opened_on").alias("last_gate_opened_on"),
        F.count("*").alias("gate_count"),
        F.count("*").alias("gate_count_2"),
    )
)

profiled = (
    outliers.alias("s")
    .join(gate_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.terminal_id") == F.col("s.terminal_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "g.last_gate_opened_on",
        F.coalesce(F.col("g.gate_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("gate_count"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("g.gate_count_2"), F.lit(0)).alias("gate_count_2"),
    )
)

summary = (
    profiled
    .filter(F.col("terminal_id").isNotNull())
    .groupBy("opened_on_year")
    .agg(
        F.max("gate_count_2").alias("max_gate_count_2"),
        F.datediff(F.max("last_gate_opened_on"), F.min("last_gate_opened_on")).alias("last_gate_opened_on_span_days"),
    )
)

result = (
    summary
    .filter(F.col("opened_on_year") <= 2025)
    .select(
        "opened_on_year",
        "max_gate_count_2",
        "last_gate_opened_on_span_days",
        F.coalesce(F.col("opened_on_year"), F.lit(0)).alias("opened_on_year_filled"),
    )
    .orderBy(F.col("opened_on_year_filled").asc(), "opened_on_year")
    .limit(10)
)
```

```sql
WITH combined AS (
    -- Stack the branches
    SELECT
        'reading' AS source,
        id AS qty,
        quality,
        site_id AS entity_id
    FROM meter_readings
    UNION
    SELECT
        'reading_2' AS source,
        id AS qty,
        quality,
        site_id AS entity_id
    FROM meter_readings
    WHERE voltage BETWEEN 213.5 AND 241.9
      AND kwh <= 81.3
)
SELECT source, COUNT(*) AS n_rows, SUM(entity_id) AS total_entity_id
FROM combined
GROUP BY source
ORDER BY source
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

reading_side = (
    df_meter_readings
    .select(
        F.lit("reading").alias("source"),
        F.col("id").alias("qty"),
        "quality",
        F.col("site_id").alias("entity_id"),
    )
)

reading_side_2 = (
    df_meter_readings
    .filter((F.col("voltage").between(213.5, 241.9)) & (F.col("kwh") <= 81.3))
    .select(
        F.lit("reading_2").alias("source"),
        F.col("id").alias("qty"),
        "quality",
        F.col("site_id").alias("entity_id"),
    )
)

combined = (
    reading_side
    .unionByName(reading_side_2)
    .distinct()
)

result = (
    combined
    .groupBy("source")
    .agg(
        F.count("*").alias("n_rows"),
        F.sum("entity_id").alias("total_entity_id"),
    )
    .orderBy("source")
)
```

```sql
WITH ranked AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY hotel_chain ORDER BY charged_at DESC) AS rank_in_group
        FROM room_types
    ) x
    WHERE rank_in_group = 1
)
SELECT
    s.id,
    s.hotel_id,
    s.hotel_chain,
    s.task_mins,
    s.late_checkout,
    s.rank_in_group,
    CASE WHEN hotel_chain RLIKE '^(Indie|Orchid)$' THEN 'GROUP_B' WHEN hotel_chain RLIKE '^(Lotus)$' THEN 'GROUP_A' ELSE 'PRIORITY' END AS hotel_chain_zone,
    (SELECT MIN(t2.task_mins) FROM room_types t2 WHERE t2.hotel_id = s.hotel_id) AS min_room_type_task_mins
FROM ranked s
ORDER BY hotel_chain DESC NULLS FIRST;
```

```python
    .orderBy(F.col("hotel_chain").desc_nulls_first())
```

```sql
WITH scoped AS (
    -- Filter table_tickets
    SELECT
        id,
        eatery_id,
        ticket_state,
        tip_amt,
        prep_minutes,
        opened_day,
        is_vegan
    FROM table_tickets
    WHERE ticket_state NOT IN ('paid', 'void')
),
with_details_eatery AS (
    -- Join eateries
    SELECT
        s.*,
        e.prep_minutes AS eatery_prep_minutes,
        e.seat_zone AS eatery_seat_zone,
        e.course_kind AS eatery_course_kind
    FROM scoped s
    JOIN eateries e ON e.id = s.eatery_id
    WHERE e.seat_zone = 'hall'
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        *,
        FIRST_VALUE(prep_minutes) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY opened_day DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_prep_minutes,
        LEAD(eatery_prep_minutes) OVER (ORDER BY opened_day DESC, id) AS next_eatery_prep_minutes,
        LEAD(prep_minutes) OVER (PARTITION BY eatery_seat_zone, is_vegan ORDER BY prep_minutes DESC, id) AS next_prep_minutes,
        LAG(eatery_prep_minutes) OVER w_all_by_opened_day AS prev_eatery_prep_minutes,
        NTILE(10) OVER (PARTITION BY eatery_seat_zone, is_vegan ORDER BY prep_minutes DESC, id) AS prep_minutes_decile,
        MAX(eatery_prep_minutes) OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(opened_day), ticket_state ORDER BY eatery_prep_minutes, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS eatery_prep_minutes_max_3_prior,
        RANK() OVER w_all_by_eatery_prep_minutes AS eatery_prep_minutes_rank,
        LAST_VALUE(opened_day) OVER (PARTITION BY eatery_seat_zone, is_vegan ORDER BY prep_minutes DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS last_opened_day,
        LEAD(tip_amt, 1, 0) OVER w_eatery_id_by_eatery_prep_min AS next_tip_amt,
        ROUND(AVG(eatery_prep_minutes) OVER (PARTITION BY eatery_seat_zone), 2) AS eatery_seat_zone_avg_eatery_prep_minutes,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ticket_state, eatery_course_kind ORDER BY eatery_prep_minutes, id) AS eatery_prep_minutes_rank_2,
        ROUND(AVG(eatery_prep_minutes) OVER (ORDER BY opened_day DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 2) AS eatery_prep_minutes_avg_1_prior,
        ROUND(AVG(tip_amt) OVER (PARTITION BY ticket_state, eatery_course_kind ORDER BY eatery_prep_minutes, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 2) AS tip_amt_avg_3_prior,
        LEAD(opened_day, 2) OVER w_all_by_opened_day AS next2_opened_day,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ticket_state, eatery_course_kind ORDER BY eatery_prep_minutes) AS eatery_prep_minutes_rank_3,
        SUM(tip_amt) OVER w_ticket_state AS ticket_state_sum_tip_amt
    FROM with_details_eatery
    WINDOW w_all_by_opened_day AS (ORDER BY opened_day DESC, id), w_all_by_eatery_prep_minutes AS (ORDER BY eatery_prep_minutes, id), w_eatery_id_by_eatery_prep_min AS (PARTITION BY eatery_id ORDER BY eatery_prep_minutes DESC, id), w_ticket_state AS (PARTITION BY ticket_state)
),
first_rows AS (
    -- Top 5 per group
    SELECT *
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE eatery_prep_minutes_rank_2 <= 5
),
grouped AS (
    -- Group-level totals
    SELECT
        eatery_seat_zone,
        is_vegan,
        MIN(next2_opened_day) AS first_next2_opened_day,
        SUM(CASE WHEN is_vegan = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_is_vegan_true,
        ROUND(SUM(tip_amt), 2) AS total_tip_amt,
        COUNT(*) AS n_rows,
        MAX(last_opened_day) AS last_last_opened_day,
        MAX(next2_opened_day) AS last_next2_opened_day
    FROM first_rows
    GROUP BY eatery_seat_zone, is_vegan
)
SELECT
    eatery_seat_zone,
    is_vegan,
    first_next2_opened_day,
    n_is_vegan_true,
    total_tip_amt,
    n_rows,
    last_next2_opened_day,
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', last_last_opened_day) AS last_last_opened_day_month
FROM grouped
ORDER BY eatery_seat_zone, total_tip_amt
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

scoped = (
    df_table_tickets
    .filter(~F.col("ticket_state").isin("paid", "void"))
    .select(
        "id",
        "eatery_id",
        "ticket_state",
        "tip_amt",
        "prep_minutes",
        "opened_day",
        "is_vegan",
    )
)

with_details_eatery = (
    scoped.alias("s")
    .join(df_eateries.alias("e"), F.col("e.id") == F.col("s.eatery_id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("e.seat_zone") == "hall")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        F.col("e.prep_minutes").alias("eatery_prep_minutes"),
        F.col("e.seat_zone").alias("eatery_seat_zone"),
        F.col("e.course_kind").alias("eatery_course_kind"),
    )
)

w_all_by_opened_day = Window.orderBy(F.col("opened_day").desc(), "id")
w_all_by_eatery_prep_minutes = Window.orderBy("eatery_prep_minutes", "id")
w_eatery_id_by_eatery_prep_min = Window.partitionBy("eatery_id").orderBy(F.col("eatery_prep_minutes").desc(), "id")
w_ticket_state = Window.partitionBy("ticket_state")
with_windows = (
    with_details_eatery
    .select(
        "*",
        F.first("prep_minutes", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.orderBy(F.col("opened_day").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_prep_minutes"),
        F.lead("eatery_prep_minutes").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("opened_day").desc(), "id")).alias("next_eatery_prep_minutes"),
        F.lead("prep_minutes").over(Window.partitionBy("eatery_seat_zone", "is_vegan").orderBy(F.col("prep_minutes").desc(), "id")).alias("next_prep_minutes"),
        F.lag("eatery_prep_minutes").over(w_all_by_opened_day).alias("prev_eatery_prep_minutes"),
        F.ntile(10).over(Window.partitionBy("eatery_seat_zone", "is_vegan").orderBy(F.col("prep_minutes").desc(), "id")).alias("prep_minutes_decile"),
        F.max("eatery_prep_minutes").over(Window.partitionBy(F.year("opened_day"), "ticket_state").orderBy("eatery_prep_minutes", "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)).alias("eatery_prep_minutes_max_3_prior"),
        F.rank().over(w_all_by_eatery_prep_minutes).alias("eatery_prep_minutes_rank"),
        F.last("opened_day").over(Window.partitionBy("eatery_seat_zone", "is_vegan").orderBy(F.col("prep_minutes").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.unboundedFollowing)).alias("last_opened_day"),
        F.lead("tip_amt", 1, 0).over(w_eatery_id_by_eatery_prep_min).alias("next_tip_amt"),
        F.round(F.avg("eatery_prep_minutes").over(Window.partitionBy("eatery_seat_zone")), 2).alias("eatery_seat_zone_avg_eatery_prep_minutes"),
        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("ticket_state", "eatery_course_kind").orderBy("eatery_prep_minutes", "id")).alias("eatery_prep_minutes_rank_2"),
        F.round(F.avg("eatery_prep_minutes").over(Window.orderBy(F.col("opened_day").desc(), "id").rowsBetween(-1, -1)), 2).alias("eatery_prep_minutes_avg_1_prior"),
        F.round(F.avg("tip_amt").over(Window.partitionBy("ticket_state", "eatery_course_kind").orderBy("eatery_prep_minutes", "id").rowsBetween(-3, -1)), 2).alias("tip_amt_avg_3_prior"),
        F.lead("opened_day", 2).over(w_all_by_opened_day).alias("next2_opened_day"),
        F.rank().over(Window.partitionBy("ticket_state", "eatery_course_kind").orderBy("eatery_prep_minutes")).alias("eatery_prep_minutes_rank_3"),
        F.sum("tip_amt").over(w_ticket_state).alias("ticket_state_sum_tip_amt"),
    )
)

first_rows = with_windows.filter(F.col("eatery_prep_minutes_rank_2") <= 5)

grouped = (
    first_rows
    .groupBy("eatery_seat_zone", "is_vegan")
    .agg(
        F.min("next2_opened_day").alias("first_next2_opened_day"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("is_vegan"), 1).otherwise(0)).alias("n_is_vegan_true"),
        F.round(F.sum("tip_amt"), 2).alias("total_tip_amt"),
        F.count("*").alias("n_rows"),
        F.max("last_opened_day").alias("last_last_opened_day"),
        F.max("next2_opened_day").alias("last_next2_opened_day"),
    )
)

result = (
    grouped
    .select(
        "eatery_seat_zone",
        "is_vegan",
        "first_next2_opened_day",
        "n_is_vegan_true",
        "total_tip_amt",
        "n_rows",
        "last_next2_opened_day",
        F.date_trunc("month", F.col("last_last_opened_day")).alias("last_last_opened_day_month"),
    )
    .orderBy("eatery_seat_zone", "total_tip_amt")
)
```

```sql
WITH scoped_voyages AS (
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        vessel_id,
        crew_role,
        reefer_temp,
        gross_tonnage,
        built_on,
        is_reefer,
        SUBSTRING(TRIM(vessel_flag), 1, 2) AS vessel_flag_prefix
    FROM voyages
    WHERE is_reefer = TRUE
      AND reefer_temp BETWEEN -20.1 AND 3.2
),
windowed AS (
    -- Window metrics over several partitions
    SELECT
        id,
        vessel_id,
        crew_role,
        reefer_temp,
        gross_tonnage,
        is_reefer,
        vessel_flag_prefix,
        SUM(reefer_temp) OVER (PARTITION BY crew_role, is_reefer ORDER BY reefer_temp ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_reefer_temp,
        ROUND(CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY crew_role, is_reefer ORDER BY reefer_temp ASC), 3) AS reefer_temp_cume_dist,
        ROUND(AVG(gross_tonnage) OVER (PARTITION BY crew_role, is_reefer ORDER BY reefer_temp ASC, id ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS gross_tonnage_avg_3
    FROM scoped_voyages
),
enriched AS (
    -- Attach vessel attributes
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.vessel_id,
        s.crew_role,
        s.reefer_temp,
        s.gross_tonnage,
        s.is_reefer,
        s.vessel_flag_prefix,
        s.running_reefer_temp,
        s.gross_tonnage_avg_3,
        v.reefer_temp AS vessel_reefer_temp,
        v.cert_tags AS vessel_cert_tags
    FROM windowed s
    LEFT JOIN vessels v ON v.id = s.vessel_id
),
enriched_vessel AS (
    -- Attach vessel attributes
    SELECT
```

```sql
    FROM base

metrics AS (

        *,

        LAG(yield_kilos) OVER (PARTITION BY harvest_grade, soil_class ORDER BY sown_date, id) AS prev_yield_kilos,
        LEAD(days_sown_date_to_sown_date_plus_months) OVER (PARTITION BY harvest_grade, soil_class ORDER BY sown_date, id) AS next_days_sown_date_to_sown_date_plus_months,
        LAG(days_sown_date_to_sown_date_plus_months) OVER (PARTITION BY harvest_grade, soil_class ORDER BY sown_date, id) AS prev_days_sown_date_to_sown_date_plus_months,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY harvest_grade, soil_class ORDER BY sown_date, id) AS event_seq
    FROM base_tbl_seed_lots
),
deduped AS (
    -- Keep one row per key (latest first)
    SELECT
        id,
        soil_class,
        sown_date_plus_months,
        days_sown_date_to_sown_date_plus_months,
        sown_date_label,
        next_yield_kilos,
        prev_yield_kilos,
        next_days_sown_date_to_sown_date_plus_months
    FROM (
        SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY harvest_grade ORDER BY yield_kilos DESC, id) AS rn
        FROM metrics
    ) x
    WHERE rn = 1
),
with_windows AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,

    FROM deduped
    WINDOW w_hist AS (PARTITION BY soil_class ORDER BY days_sown_date_to_sown_date_plus_months, id ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING)

    COUNT(*) AS cnt,
    SORT_ARRAY(COLLECT_SET(soil_class)) AS soil_class_list,
```

```sql
        outlet_id,
        outlet_format,
        restock_quantity,
        shrink_units,
        promo_start_day
    FROM shelf_audits

joined_outlet AS (
    -- Attach outlet attributes
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.outlet_id,
        s.shrink_units,
        s.promo_start_day,
        o.out_of_stock AS outlet_out_of_stock,
        o.promo_lift_pct AS outlet_promo_lift_pct
    FROM scoped s
    LEFT JOIN outlets o ON o.id = s.outlet_id
),
windowed AS (
    -- Previous / next values per key
    SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY outlet_id, outlet_out_of_stock) AS rows_in_outlet_id_outlet_out_of_stock,
        ROUND(shrink_units / NULLIF(SUM(shrink_units) OVER (PARTITION BY outlet_id, outlet_out_of_stock), 0), 4) AS shrink_units_share_of_outlet_id_outlet_out_of_st,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER w_outlet_out_of_stock_by_shrin AS seq_no,
        ROUND(shrink_units - AVG(shrink_units) OVER (PARTITION BY outlet_id, outlet_out_of_stock), 2) AS shrink_units_vs_outlet_id_outlet_out_of_stock_av,
        ROUND(AVG(shrink_units) OVER (PARTITION BY outlet_out_of_stock ORDER BY shrink_units DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS shrink_units_avg_7,
        LAST_VALUE(shrink_units) IGNORE NULLS OVER (PARTITION BY outlet_out_of_stock ORDER BY shrink_units DESC, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS last_known_shrink_units
    FROM joined_outlet
    WINDOW w_outlet_out_of_stock_by_shrin AS (PARTITION BY outlet_out_of_stock ORDER BY shrink_units DESC, id)
),
with_activity AS (
    -- Rows with no matching promo_runs
    SELECT s.*
    FROM windowed s
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM promo_runs p
            WHERE p.outlet_id = s.outlet_id
              AND p.facings <= 16
              AND p.audit_result <> 'misplaced'
        )
),
totals AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        seq_no,
        SUM(shrink_units) AS total_shrink_units,
        SUM(CASE WHEN outlet_out_of_stock = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_outlet_out_of_stock_false,
        SUM(CASE WHEN outlet_out_of_stock = TRUE THEN last_known_shrink_units ELSE 0 END) AS last_known_shrink_units_outlet_out_of_stock_true,
        SUM(shrink_units_share_of_outlet_id_outlet_out_of_st) AS total_shrink_units_share_of_outlet_id_outlet_out
    FROM with_activity
```

```sql
        term,
        grade_status,
        enrolled_at
    FROM enrollments
    WHERE enrolled_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-02-18 08:00:00'
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous enrolled_at per student_id
    SELECT *, LAG(enrolled_at) OVER (PARTITION BY student_id ORDER BY enrolled_at, id) AS prev_enrolled_at
    FROM valid
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 45 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_enrolled_at IS NULL OR enrolled_at > prev_enrolled_at + INTERVAL 45 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY student_id ORDER BY enrolled_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
per_session AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        student_id,
        session_id,
        MIN(enrolled_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(enrolled_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(enrolled_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(enrolled_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY student_id, session_id
),
enrollment_stats AS (
    -- Per-student enrollments metrics
    SELECT student_id, MIN(score) AS min_enrollment_score
    FROM enrollments
    GROUP BY student_id
),
with_stats AS (
    -- Attach enrollments metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        e.min_enrollment_score
    FROM per_session s
    LEFT JOIN enrollment_stats e ON e.student_id = s.student_id
)
-- Final projection
SELECT

    session_end,
    event_count,
    duration_min,
    min_enrollment_score,

FROM with_stats
```

```sql
    SELECT
```

```sql
        account_id,
        txn_type,
        amount,
        txn_time,
        merchant,
        txn_time_day,
        SUM(new_group_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY txn_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        LENGTH(txn_type) AS txn_type_length,
        SUBSTRING(merchant, 1, 3) AS merchant_prefix
    FROM islands
    WHERE txn_time >= TO_DATE('2023-08-18')

gaps AS (

    FROM prev_events
),
islands_transactions AS (
```

```sql
    SELECT
        id,
        warehouse_id,
        sku_id,
        move_type,
        moved_at,
        operator,
        CASE WHEN move_type IN ('TRANSFER', 'OUTBOUND') THEN 'group_a' WHEN move_type = 'ADJUST' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS move_type_group
    FROM stock_moves
    WHERE HOUR(moved_at) BETWEEN 8 AND 13
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous moved_at per operator
    SELECT *, LAG(moved_at) OVER (PARTITION BY operator ORDER BY moved_at, id) AS prev_moved_at
    FROM filtered
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 60 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_moved_at IS NULL OR (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(moved_at) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(prev_moved_at)) / 60 > 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session_flag
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(new_session_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY operator ORDER BY moved_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
sessions AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        operator,
        session_id,
        MIN(moved_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(moved_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(moved_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(moved_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY operator, session_id
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    operator,
    session_id,
    session_start,
    session_end,
    events,
    duration_min,
    LOWER(REGEXP_REPLACE(TRIM(operator), ' ', '_')) AS operator_slug
FROM sessions
ORDER BY operator
```

```sql
    -- Scope the ticket_events rows
    SELECT
        id,
        ticket_id,
        event_at,
        event_type,
        actor
    FROM ticket_events
),
with_prev AS (
    -- Previous event_at per ticket_id
    SELECT *, LAG(event_at) OVER (PARTITION BY ticket_id ORDER BY event_at, id) AS prev_event_at
    FROM scoped_events
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 30 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_event_at IS NULL OR event_at > prev_event_at + INTERVAL 30 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS starts_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(starts_session) OVER (PARTITION BY ticket_id ORDER BY event_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
sessions AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        ticket_id,
        burst_id,
        MIN(event_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(event_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(event_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(event_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY ticket_id, burst_id
),
with_parent_ticket AS (
    -- Attach ticket attributes
    SELECT
        s.ticket_id,
        s.burst_id,
        s.events,
        s.duration_min,
        t.csat AS ticket_csat,
        t.tags AS ticket_tags
    FROM sessions s
    JOIN tickets t ON t.id = s.ticket_id
    WHERE t.csat < 4
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    ticket_id,
    burst_id,
    events,
    ticket_tags,
    ABS(burst_id - 4) AS burst_id_distance
FROM with_parent_ticket
ORDER BY ticket_id DESC, events DESC
```

```sql
WITH with_windows AS (
    -- Ranking and gap features
    SELECT
        id,
        customer_id,
        plan,
        end_date,
        monthly_fee,
        status,
        AVG(monthly_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY end_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_avg_monthly_fee,
        COUNT(monthly_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY end_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_count_monthly_fee,
        SUM(monthly_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY end_date, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_monthly_fee
    FROM subscriptions
),
with_windows_subscriptions AS (
    -- Running and moving aggregates
    SELECT
        *,
        AVG(monthly_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY running_sum_monthly_fee, id ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS monthly_fee_avg_3_prior,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY plan ORDER BY running_avg_monthly_fee DESC) AS running_avg_monthly_fee_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY MONTH(end_date), plan ORDER BY monthly_fee DESC, id) AS seq_no,
        ROUND(monthly_fee / SUM(monthly_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id, status), 4) AS monthly_fee_share
    FROM with_windows
    WHERE running_avg_monthly_fee >= 90
),
with_window AS (
    -- Non-equi join on a validity window
    SELECT
        src.*,
        sub.id AS subscription_id,
        sub.plan AS subscription_plan,
        sub.monthly_fee AS subscription_monthly_fee
    FROM with_windows_subscriptions src
    LEFT JOIN subscriptions sub
        ON src.customer_id = sub.customer_id
       AND src.end_date >= sub.start_date
       AND src.end_date <= DATE_ADD(sub.end_date, 10)
),
enriched AS (
    -- Window metrics over several different partitions
    SELECT
        *,
        FIRST_VALUE(seq_no) IGNORE NULLS OVER (ORDER BY seq_no, id, subscription_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS first_known_seq_no,
        LAG(running_avg_monthly_fee_rank, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', end_date), subscription_plan ORDER BY monthly_fee, id, subscription_id) AS prev_running_avg_monthly_fee_rank,
        SUM(running_count_monthly_fee) OVER (PARTITION BY plan, subscription_plan ORDER BY seq_no, id, subscription_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_running_count_monthly_fee
    FROM with_window
),
deduped AS (
    -- QUALIFY-style window filter
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY prev_running_avg_monthly_fee_rank DESC NULLS FIRST, id, subscription_id) AS latest_rank
    FROM enriched
    QUALIFY latest_rank = 1
)
SELECT
    s.id,
    s.customer_id,
    s.plan,
    s.monthly_fee,
    s.status,
    s.running_avg_monthly_fee,
    s.running_sum_monthly_fee,
    s.monthly_fee_avg_3_prior,
    s.running_avg_monthly_fee_rank,
    CASE WHEN status RLIKE '^(PAUSED|EXPIRED)$' THEN 'CORE' WHEN status RLIKE '^(ACTIVE|CANCELLED)$' THEN 'GROUP_B' ELSE 'GROUP_A' END AS status_zone,
    (SELECT MAX(x.monthly_fee) FROM subscriptions x WHERE x.customer_id = s.customer_id) AS max_subscription_monthly_fee
FROM deduped s
ORDER BY running_avg_monthly_fee_rank, status_zone DESC
```

```sql
    COALESCE(a.red_total_lesson_minutes, 0) AS red_total_lesson_minutes,
    COALESCE(b.green_count, 0) AS green_count,
    b.green_avg_lesson_minutes,
    COALESCE(a.red_count, 0) - COALESCE(b.green_count, 0) AS net_count
FROM red_monthly a
```

```python
    )
)

result = (

    .select(
        F.coalesce(F.col("a.enrolled_on_month"), F.col("b.enrolled_on_month")).alias("enrolled_on_month"),
```

```sql
    FROM filtered
```

```sql
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(starts_session) OVER (PARTITION BY agent_id ORDER BY opened_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS burst_id
    FROM flagged
),
per_session AS (

    SELECT
        agent_id,
        burst_id,
        MIN(opened_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(opened_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS events,
        SUM(requester_id) AS session_requester_id,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(opened_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(opened_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY agent_id, burst_id
),
grouped AS (
    -- Aggregate with conditional metrics
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', session_start) AS session_start_month,
        ROUND(STDDEV(burst_id), 2) AS stddev_burst_id,

    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', session_start)
)

    session_start_month,

    first_session_start,
```

```sql
    -- Keep valid rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        id,
        terminal_id,
        lane_throughput,
        opened_on,
        service_codes,
        COALESCE(bag_state, 'UNKNOWN') AS bag_state_or_unknown,
        YEAR(opened_on) AS opened_on_year,
        CASE WHEN bag_state IN ('delayed', 'lost') THEN 'group_a' WHEN bag_state = 'claimed' THEN 'group_b' ELSE 'other' END AS bag_state_group
    FROM golden_buoys
),
terminal_id_stats AS (
    -- Avg opened_on_year per terminal_id
    SELECT terminal_id, AVG(opened_on_year) AS avg_opened_on_year
    FROM base_gates
    GROUP BY terminal_id
),
outliers AS (
    -- Rows compared with their group statistic
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.avg_opened_on_year,
        ROUND(s.opened_on_year - g.avg_opened_on_year, 2) AS opened_on_year_minus_avg
    FROM base_gates s
    JOIN terminal_id_stats g ON g.terminal_id = s.terminal_id
    WHERE s.opened_on_year > g.avg_opened_on_year
),
gate_stats AS (
    -- Per-terminal golden_buoys metrics
    SELECT
        terminal_id,
        MAX(opened_on) AS last_gate_opened_on,
        COUNT(*) AS gate_count,
        COUNT(*) AS gate_count_2
    FROM golden_buoys
    GROUP BY terminal_id
),
profiled AS (
    -- Attach golden_buoys metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        g.last_gate_opened_on,
        COALESCE(g.gate_count, 0) AS gate_count,
        COALESCE(g.gate_count_2, 0) AS gate_count_2
    FROM outliers s
    LEFT JOIN gate_stats g ON g.terminal_id = s.terminal_id
),
summary AS (
    -- Group-level totals
    SELECT
        opened_on_year,
        MAX(gate_count_2) AS max_gate_count_2,
        DATEDIFF(MAX(last_gate_opened_on), MIN(last_gate_opened_on)) AS last_gate_opened_on_span_days
    FROM profiled
    WHERE terminal_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 1
)
-- Final projection
SELECT
    opened_on_year,
    max_gate_count_2,
    last_gate_opened_on_span_days,
    COALESCE(opened_on_year, 0) AS opened_on_year_filled
FROM summary
WHERE opened_on_year <= 2025
ORDER BY opened_on_year_filled, opened_on_year
LIMIT 10
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F

base_gates = (
    df_golden_buoys
    .select(
        "id",
        "terminal_id",
        "lane_throughput",
        "opened_on",
        "service_codes",
        F.coalesce(F.col("bag_state"), F.lit("UNKNOWN")).alias("bag_state_or_unknown"),
        F.year(F.col("opened_on")).alias("opened_on_year"),
        F.when(F.col("bag_state").isin("delayed", "lost"), "group_a").when(F.col("bag_state") == "claimed", "group_b").otherwise("other").alias("bag_state_group"),
    )
)

terminal_id_stats = (
    base_gates
    .groupBy("terminal_id")
    .agg(F.avg("opened_on_year").alias("avg_opened_on_year"))
)

outliers = (
    base_gates.alias("s")
    .join(terminal_id_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.terminal_id") == F.col("s.terminal_id"), "inner")
    .filter(F.col("s.opened_on_year") > F.col("g.avg_opened_on_year"))
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "g.avg_opened_on_year",
        F.round(F.col("s.opened_on_year") - F.col("g.avg_opened_on_year"), 2).alias("opened_on_year_minus_avg"),
    )
)

gate_stats = (
    df_golden_buoys
    .groupBy("terminal_id")
    .agg(
        F.max("opened_on").alias("last_gate_opened_on"),
        F.count("*").alias("gate_count"),
        F.count("*").alias("gate_count_2"),
    )
)

profiled = (
    outliers.alias("s")
    .join(gate_stats.alias("g"), F.col("g.terminal_id") == F.col("s.terminal_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "g.last_gate_opened_on",
        F.coalesce(F.col("g.gate_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("gate_count"),
        F.coalesce(F.col("g.gate_count_2"), F.lit(0)).alias("gate_count_2"),
    )
)

summary = (
    profiled
    .filter(F.col("terminal_id").isNotNull())
    .groupBy("opened_on_year")
    .agg(
        F.max("gate_count_2").alias("max_gate_count_2"),
        F.datediff(F.max("last_gate_opened_on"), F.min("last_gate_opened_on")).alias("last_gate_opened_on_span_days"),
    )
)

result = (
    summary
    .filter(F.col("opened_on_year") <= 2025)
    .select(
        "opened_on_year",
        "max_gate_count_2",
        "last_gate_opened_on_span_days",
```

```sql
    FROM tbl_codices

with_prev AS (
    -- Previous enrolled_at per student_id
    SELECT *, LAG(enrolled_at) OVER (PARTITION BY student_id ORDER BY enrolled_at, id) AS prev_enrolled_at
    FROM valid
),
flagged AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session (gap > 45 minutes)
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_enrolled_at IS NULL OR enrolled_at > prev_enrolled_at + INTERVAL 45 MINUTES THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_new_session
    FROM with_prev
),
sessionized AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT *, SUM(is_new_session) OVER (PARTITION BY student_id ORDER BY enrolled_at, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS session_id
    FROM flagged
),
per_session AS (
    -- One row per session
    SELECT
        student_id,
        session_id,
        MIN(enrolled_at) AS session_start,
        MAX(enrolled_at) AS session_end,
        COUNT(*) AS event_count,
        ROUND((UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(enrolled_at)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(enrolled_at))) / 60, 1) AS duration_min
    FROM sessionized
    GROUP BY student_id, session_id
),
enrollment_stats AS (
    -- Per-student tbl_codices metrics

    FROM tbl_codices
    GROUP BY student_id
),
with_stats AS (
    -- Attach tbl_codices metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        e.min_enrollment_score
    FROM per_session s
    LEFT JOIN enrollment_stats e ON e.student_id = s.student_id
)
-- Final projection

    session_end,
    event_count,
    duration_min,
    min_enrollment_score,
    DATEDIFF(DATE '2025-12-31', session_end) AS days_since_session_end
FROM with_stats
```

```sql
with_stats AS (

        s.*,
```

```sql
    FROM scored s

FROM with_stats
```

```sql
    FROM base

    SELECT
```

```sql
        account_id,
        txn_type,
        amount,
        txn_time,
        merchant,
        txn_time_day,
        SUM(new_group_flag) OVER (PARTITION BY merchant ORDER BY txn_time, id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS western_dredge
    FROM flagged
),
cleaned AS (
    -- Filter the raw rows and derive helper columns
    SELECT
        *,
        LENGTH(txn_type) AS txn_type_length,
        SUBSTRING(merchant, 1, 3) AS jade_market
    FROM islands
    WHERE txn_time >= TO_DATE('2023-08-18')
      AND western_dredge <= 7

prev_events AS (

    SELECT *, LAG(txn_time) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY txn_time, id) AS prev_txn_time
    FROM cleaned
),
gaps AS (
    -- Flag rows that start a new session
    SELECT *, CASE WHEN prev_txn_time IS NULL OR txn_time > prev_txn_time + INTERVAL 60 DAYS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_group_flag
    FROM prev_events

islands_transactions AS (
    -- Running sum of the flag = session number
    SELECT
        id,
        account_id,
        txn_type,

wide AS (
```

```sql
    FROM with_prev

sessionized AS (

    FROM flagged
```

```python
filtered = (
    df_creameries_events
    .filter((F.col("offer_state").isin("pending", "accepted")) & (F.col("monthly_rent").between(1651.5, 7358.4)))
    .select(

)
```

```sql
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY listing_id, has_parking ORDER BY bedroom_cnt, id) AS bedroom_cnt_dense_rank,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY listing_id, has_parking ORDER BY bedroom_cnt) AS bedroom_cnt_dense_rank_2,

        ROUND(storey_no - AVG(storey_no) OVER (PARTITION BY district_code), 2) AS storey_no_vs_district_code_avg
    FROM base
),
line_level AS (
    -- One row per offer
    SELECT
        s.id,
        s.listing_id,
        s.bedroom_cnt,
        s.asking_price,
        s.storey_no,
        s.offer_made_at,
        s.street_line,

        o.listing_status AS offer_listing_status,
        o.property_kind AS offer_property_kind,
        o.offer_made_at AS offer_offer_made_at,
        o.bedroom_cnt AS offer_bedroom_cnt
    FROM windowed s
    JOIN polar_canisters o ON o.listing_id = s.listing_id
),
metrics AS (
    -- Rank and compare rows within groups
    SELECT
        *,
        COUNT(*) OVER w_listing_id AS rows_in_listing_id,
        ROUND(asking_price / NULLIF(SUM(asking_price) OVER w_listing_id, 0), 4) AS asking_price_share_of_listing_id
    FROM line_level
    WINDOW w_listing_id AS (PARTITION BY listing_id)
),
valuation_stats AS (
    -- Per-listing grotto_gorges metrics
    SELECT
        willow_windmill,
        MIN(offer_amt) AS min_valuation_offer_amt,
        COUNT(*) AS valuation_count
    FROM grotto_gorges
    GROUP BY willow_windmill
),
profiled AS (
    -- Attach grotto_gorges metrics
    SELECT
        s.*,
        f.min_valuation_offer_amt,
        COALESCE(f.valuation_count, 0) AS valuation_count
    FROM metrics s
    LEFT JOIN valuation_stats f ON f.willow_windmill = s.listing_id
)
-- Subtotals with GROUPING SETS
SELECT
    listing_id,
    COALESCE(offer_listing_status, 'ALL') AS offer_listing_status,
    GROUPING(listing_id) AS is_total_listing_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN offer_listing_status IN ('SOLD', 'ACTIVE') THEN storey_no_vs_district_code_avg ELSE 0 END) AS storey_no_vs_district_code_avg_offer_listing_sta,
    MIN(offer_offer_made_at) AS first_offer_offer_made_at,
    ROUND(SUM(bedroom_cnt) / NULLIF(SUM(min_valuation_offer_amt), 0), 3) AS bedroom_cnt_to_min_valuation_offer_amt_ratio
FROM profiled
GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((listing_id, offer_listing_status), (listing_id), ())
ORDER BY listing_id NULLS LAST, offer_listing_status NULLS LAST
```

```python
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.window import Window

base = (
    df_dim_warehouses
    .filter(F.col("district_code") == "D01")
    .select(
        "id",
        "listing_id",
        "district_code",
        "bedroom_cnt",
        "asking_price",
        "storey_no",
        "offer_made_at",
        "street_line",
        "has_parking",
        "amenity_codes",
        F.upper(F.trim(F.col("property_kind"))).alias("angler_code"),
        F.substring(F.trim(F.col("street_line")), 1, 2).alias("street_line_prefix"),
        F.array_join(F.array_sort(F.col("amenity_codes")), ",").alias("amenity_codes_text"),
    )
)

windowed = (
    base
    .select(
        "*",
        F.count(F.lit(1)).over(Window.partitionBy("listing_id", "has_parking").orderBy("bedroom_cnt", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("running_count"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("listing_id", "has_parking").orderBy("bedroom_cnt", "id")).alias("bedroom_cnt_dense_rank"),
        F.dense_rank().over(Window.partitionBy("listing_id", "has_parking").orderBy("bedroom_cnt")).alias("bedroom_cnt_dense_rank_2"),
        F.first("bedroom_cnt", ignorenulls=True).over(Window.partitionBy("listing_id", "has_parking").orderBy("bedroom_cnt", "id").rowsBetween(Window.unboundedPreceding, Window.currentRow)).alias("first_known_bedroom_cnt"),
        F.round(F.col("storey_no") - F.avg("storey_no").over(Window.partitionBy("district_code")), 2).alias("storey_no_vs_district_code_avg"),
    )
)

line_level = (
    windowed.alias("s")
    .join(df_polar_canisters.alias("o"), F.col("o.listing_id") == F.col("s.listing_id"), "inner")
    .select(
        "s.id",
        "s.listing_id",
        "s.bedroom_cnt",
        "s.asking_price",
        "s.storey_no",
        "s.offer_made_at",
        "s.street_line",
        "s.angler_code",
        "s.street_line_prefix",
        "s.amenity_codes_text",
        "s.running_count",
        "s.bedroom_cnt_dense_rank_2",
        "s.storey_no_vs_district_code_avg",
        F.col("o.id").alias("offer_id"),
        F.col("o.listing_status").alias("offer_listing_status"),
        F.col("o.property_kind").alias("offer_property_kind"),
        F.col("o.offer_made_at").alias("offer_offer_made_at"),
        F.col("o.bedroom_cnt").alias("offer_bedroom_cnt"),
    )
)

w_listing_id = Window.partitionBy("listing_id")
metrics = (
    line_level
    .withColumn("rows_in_listing_id", F.count(F.lit(1)).over(w_listing_id))
    .withColumn("asking_price_share_of_listing_id", F.round(F.col("asking_price") / F.nullif(F.sum("asking_price").over(w_listing_id), F.lit(0)), 4))
)

valuation_stats = (
    df_grotto_gorges
    .groupBy("willow_windmill")
    .agg(
        F.min("offer_amt").alias("min_valuation_offer_amt"),
        F.count("*").alias("valuation_count"),
    )
)

profiled = (
    metrics.alias("s")
    .join(valuation_stats.alias("f"), F.col("f.willow_windmill") == F.col("s.listing_id"), "left")
    .select(
        "s.*",
        "f.min_valuation_offer_amt",
        F.coalesce(F.col("f.valuation_count"), F.lit(0)).alias("valuation_count"),
    )
)

result = (
    profiled
    .groupingSets(
        [["listing_id", "offer_listing_status"], ["listing_id"], []],
        "listing_id", "offer_listing_status",
    )
    .agg(
        F.grouping("listing_id").alias("is_total_listing_id"),
        F.sum(F.when(F.col("offer_listing_status").isin("SOLD", "ACTIVE"), F.col("storey_no_vs_district_code_avg")).otherwise(0)).alias("storey_no_vs_district_code_avg_offer_listing_sta"),
        F.min("offer_offer_made_at").alias("first_offer_offer_made_at"),
        F.round(F.sum("bedroom_cnt") / F.nullif(F.sum("min_valuation_offer_amt"), F.lit(0)), 3).alias("bedroom_cnt_to_min_valuation_offer_amt_ratio"),
    )
    .select(
        "listing_id",
        F.coalesce(F.col("offer_listing_status"), F.lit("ALL")).alias("offer_listing_status"),
        "is_total_listing_id",
        "storey_no_vs_district_code_avg_offer_listing_sta",
        "first_offer_offer_made_at",
        "bedroom_cnt_to_min_valuation_offer_amt_ratio",
    )
    .orderBy(
        F.col("listing_id").asc_nulls_last(),
        F.col("offer_listing_status").asc_nulls_last(),
    )
)

```

```python
    df_sessions.alias("s")
```

```python
        "left_anti",
```
